title: Scalable Distortion-Aware Clustering for Fronthaul-Limited Cell-Free MIMO Networks
summary: This paper studies distortion-aware clustering for uplink fronthaul-limited cell-free MIMO networks employing maximum ratio combining (MRC). While MRC is appealing for its low-complexity, its performance is limited by interference, fronthaul distortions, and channel imperfections. This motivates clustering strategies that compensate for these impairments through coordination of access points.
